transcript.text: During my classroom pilot this week, I found that the Civic Lens curriculum actually requires exactly ten class lessons — not eight as listed in the current implementation draft. Additionally, the podcast task works only when students record in pairs; the individual podcast format described in the draft did not work effectively in practice. I completed the pilot this week but have not yet updated the implementation draft to reflect these findings.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Shah. Those are critical findings — the lesson count and podcast format both need to be corrected in the draft. Now, as I previewed earlier, I have an important issue to raise from my review. I examined the executed vendor license in the procurement file, and I confirmed that student files may be stored only in the district LMS — with no uploads to the vendor workspace. The signed license is in the procurement file, but it has not been attached to the curriculum plan. This directly conflicts with the current implementation draft, which states that student files will use the vendor's online workspace. We need to revise that provision before Dr. Lee considers approval, or we would be operating outside the terms of our license agreement.
